fee_notes: Royalty of 6% of Gross Revenue due 10th of month for prior month; not uniformly imposed for individual vs. multi-unit franchisees. National Advertising 2% of Gross Revenue per location per month. Advertising Cooperative up to 2% of Gross Revenue if implemented in franchisee's Area. PPC Marketing set by franchisee not to exceed 2% of Gross Revenue per month (optional). Monthly Software Fee $295/month (vendor-set, no profit to franchisor). Technology Fee $170/month (may increase up to maximum of $850/month). Transfer Fee $0-$10,000. Franchise Renewal Fee $10,000. Interest on late payments 1.5%/month (18% annual). Bank fees: $45 NSF, 3% credit card transaction fee. Administrative Fee for Non-Compliance $200/occurrence/day. Administrative Fee for Lease Assistance $200/occurrence. Audit cost plus 1.5%/month interest on understatement if understatement >=1% of Gross Revenue.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee | 6% of Gross Revenue (Note 2) | Due on the 10th day of the month for the prior month | Required of you and will be collected electronically. Royalties are not uniformly imposed for individual franchisees and multi-unit franchises.
National Advertising | 2% of Gross Revenue per location per month. (Note 2) | Due on the 10th day of the month for the prior month | Required of you and will be collected electronically.
Advertising Cooperative | Up to 2% of Gross Revenue if implemented in your Area. | As Determined by Cooperative | We reserve the right to implement cooperatives in any metro markets in the future, once 3 franchises are open and operational within a specific Metro Area.
Pay-Per-Click ("PPC") Marketing | Will vary under circumstances Set by franchisee not to exceed 2% of Gross Revenue per month. | As incurred or deducted monthly on the 1st of the month.
Monthly Software Fee | $295 per month | Due on the 1st day of the month for the prior month | Paid to us in the same manner as the Royalty Fee, plus tax where applicable. This fee is set by the vendor. We do not make a profit on this fee.
Technology Fee | $170 per month | Due on the 1st day of the month for the prior month | Paid to us in the same manner as the Royalty Fee. The Fee includes use of our proprietary digital tools. This fee may increase over time to a maximum of $850 per month.
